# Why buyers get this wrong

This draft is written to fail every guardrail in scripts/blog-draft.mjs, so that a green result on this file is treated as a broken validator rather than a good article.

## 1. It names a franchise

The article references Marvel and Bluey and Pixar, which this site does not supply. 供应商图片里残留的中文也会被这里抓住。

## 2. It makes claims we cannot back

We are BSCI certified and ISO 9001 audited, and we guarantee delivery in 15 days at 4.20 USD each.

1. A numbered list is not supported by the renderer
2. It would render as plain paragraphs

| Column | Column |

| table | not rendered |

![a screenshot](https://example.com/shot.png)

## 3. It links out

Read more at https://www.reddit.com/r/costumes and see `inline code` which the renderer prints literally.

## 4. It is far too short

The house format runs to several hundred words because a thin page earns nothing.
